messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning a rolling maintenance on NZ edge GPU pool (apac-south-1) this Sun 02:00-04:00 UTC. Kernel + NIC driver update + BMC soft reboots. Expect ~12 GPUs offline at any given time, ~10-12% capacity impact. I'll post the exact cohort list shortly.

maya: What's the failure blast radius if NIC update flaps? Any risk of a region-level partition? :thinking_face:

alex: Low probability, but NIC changes historically cause transient egress hiccups on a single rack. We'll stagger cohorts across racks and validate egress after each cohort. If we see repeated link resets we'll stop and fallback to a driver rollback.

jorge: Can we shift warm traffic to AU (apac-east) for the window? If routing is simple we could prime kv-cache there to avoid tail latency spikes.

alex: Yes, smart-routing policy can steer non-latency-critical requests to apac-east. Plan: 1) drain cohort, 2) apply patch, 3) smoke test, 4) uncordon. We'll run a small canary first (node-05).

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4123 — window Sun 02:00-04:00 UTC. Automated customer emails queued for 24h and 1h before. :white_check_mark:

maya: Need to confirm customers with pinned Dedicated capacity in apac-south. They can't be auto-shifted. Who owns the list?

alex: I've exported tenant map to the ticket. Dedicated customers flagged — we'll send a manual ops contact email. Expect 2 customers affected; SRE to coordinate with AMs.

sre_oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Runbook link: `docs/runbooks/apac-south-nic-roll.md`. Escalation: pager to SRE lead -> infra eng -> oncall infra. If throughput drops >20% for >5min we'll rollback.

jorge: Suggest adding a preheat step: run `reseed-kv-cache --region apac-east --keys=top-50` 30m before to reduce cache-miss storms. Also set batching to 2 for 15m after each cohort.

alex: Good call. I'll add a preheat job and a short config override: `batch_size: 2` on the router for 15m post-cohort.

ops-bot: Cohorts assigned: [nz-rack-1: nodes 01-04], [nz-rack-2: nodes 05-08], [nz-rack-3: nodes 09-12]. Canary: nz-rack-2/node-05.

maya: Can we get a quick command snippet for node drain so support can reproduce?

alex: Sure — paste into ops guide:```\nkubectl drain node/nz-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120\n# wait for pods to reschedule, validate tps/errors\nkubectl cordon node/nz-05\n```

jorge: We'll also toggle route healthchecks to 10s during the window to detect bad egress quicker.

alex: Cost note: temporary cross-region burst will add ~USD 120 for the window (egress + extra infra). Flagged to finance.

maya: Thanks — please add a short blurb for Support Slack and paste the canary smoke checklist.

alex: Done: support message queued. Canary smoke checklist in ticket: 1) CPU/GPU temp stable, 2) egress p95 < 120ms, 3) error rate < 0.2% for 5m.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before -> support channel, 1h before -> ops-oncall. All set. :bell:
